versions.content: Indentifiaction of an EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue match Status: DRAFT If an EthCtrlConfig have multiple EthCtrlConfigEgressQueues configured, then the EthCtrlConfigEgressQueueSortingType with the highest priority i.e. lowest index of EthCtrlConfigEgressQueueSortingEntry shall be applied to identify a match for this Ethernet frame. If no match could be identified, proceed in de- scending order with the next sorting EthCtrlConfigEgressQueueSortingType.
